last_skip.detail: The historic Galleria del Cavallino (founded 1942 by Carlo Cardazzo) permanently closed in 2003, per Comune di Venezia/Artribune coverage of its archive going to Fondazione Bevilacqua La Masa/Fondazione Cini; it is not an operating venue. The TODO's address (P.za San Marco 50/A) and website (ravagnangallery.com) actually correspond to a different, currently active business, Galleria Ravagnan, but the web_fetch tool returned "permission denied" for every page on ravagnangallery.com, so no current exhibition, hours, or confirmation could be obtained from that venue's own site. Given the name/venue mismatch and inability to fetch the site directly, this could not be verified as instructed.
